data.description:
## Description

**What**: Restructure respond-to-pr-comments Step 3 with a Phase A author classifier that distinguishes 5 outcomes using `user.type == "Bot"` as the canonical bot discriminator, then routes humans/dso-llm/allowlisted-bots to Phase B for content classification.

**Why**: Today bot comments (CodeRabbit, Gitar, Copilot) enter the resolve/defend gate alongside humans, polluting the cycle counter and ingest path. The Phase A classifier is the chokepoint that prevents this — every downstream story (telemetry-collect, auto-resolve) depends on bot comments being identified at ingest.

**Scope**:
- IN: respond-to-pr-comments Step 3 two-phase prompt restructure; pr-comment-response.sh JSON schema extension (user_type + user_login fields, backward-compat); 9 fixtures under tests/fixtures/bot-comments/; Phase A author-classifier test
- OUT: per-bot parsers (covered by d3); thread auto-resolve (covered by d5); CI workflow wiring (covered by d7)

## Done Definitions

- When this story is complete, 9 fixtures route to expected outcomes (human->B, dso-llm->mirror, allowlisted bots->STOP-telemetry, bot:other->STOP-other, dependabot->STOP-no-classify)
  ← Satisfies: sc-2  (sc-2: "The Phase A author-classifier in the modified `respond-to-pr-comments` correctly distinguishes 5 outcomes using `user.type == "Bot"` as the canonical ")
- When this story is complete, pr-comment-response.sh JSON includes user_type+user_login backward-compat
  ← Satisfies: sc-1  (sc-1: "After this epic ships, a CodeRabbit / Gitar / Copilot review comment on a representative PR does NOT increment our cycle counter, does NOT enter the r")
- When this story is complete, pr_comments.bot_authors='' causes startup non-zero with empty-allowlist error
  ← Satisfies: sc-7  (sc-7: "`pr_comments.bot_authors` config controls the allowlist with case-insensitive matching; empty-string value fails fast at startup with a clear error. N")
- When this story is complete, Allowlist case-insensitive; non-allowlisted Bot routes STOP-no-classify with no label
  ← Satisfies: sc-7  (sc-7: "`pr_comments.bot_authors` config controls the allowlist with case-insensitive matching; empty-string value fails fast at startup with a clear error. N")
- When this story is complete, Config-isolated integration test (HOME=empty, no inherited env) passes
  ← Satisfies: sc-2  (sc-2: "The Phase A author-classifier in the modified `respond-to-pr-comments` correctly distinguishes 5 outcomes using `user.type == "Bot"` as the canonical ")

## Considerations
- [Testing] 9-fixture integration test must run against Phase A in isolation (no Phase B coupling) — config-isolated per bug-5f2a-9a9f
- [Reliability] Backward-compat: existing JSON consumers must continue to work without user_type/user_login

## Escalation Policy

**Escalation policy**: Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue — one that could send the implementation in the wrong direction. Escalate only when genuinely blocked without a reasonable inference. Document all assumptions made without escalating.
data.title: As a PR classifier engineer, I can rely on respond-to-pr-comments Phase A to distinguish bots from humans before any resolve/defend logic runs
